분.forms: 분이 · 분을 · plain: 사람 · 이분 · 몇 분
분.x: That gentleman is the president of our company.
분.e: Polite word for 사람: 이분 'this person'. Watch out: 분 also means 'minute'.
분.t: Restaurant staff ask 몇 분이세요? (How many people?). Don't use 분 for yourself. Not to be confused with 분 'minute'.

분.forms: Sino-Korean number + 분: 십 분 · 삼십 분
분.x: It takes fifteen minutes from home to school.
분.e: Minutes use Sino numbers: 세 시 십 분 = 3:10.
분.t: Homonym: 분 is also the honorific counter for people — 두 분 = two (respected) people.

가운데.ex: 사진 가운데에 있는 사람이 제 동생이에요.
가운데.x: The person in the middle of the photo is my younger sibling.
가운데.e: Also means 'among': 우리 가운데 = among us.

책상.x: There is a computer on the desk.
책상.t: Pronounced [책쌍]: ㅅ after a ㄱ batchim becomes tense ㅆ.

깨우다.ex: 내일 아침 일곱 시에 저 좀 깨워 주세요.
깨우다.x: Please wake me up at seven tomorrow morning.
깨우다.e: Causative of 깨다 (to wake): 'make someone wake.'

스카프.ex: 어머니 생신 선물로 예쁜 스카프를 샀어요.
스카프.x: I bought a pretty scarf for my mother's birthday.
스카프.e: From English 'scarf'; usually means a thin, decorative one.

햄.x: I put ham and egg in the gimbap.

던지다.ex: 아이들이 공원에서 공을 던지며 놀고 있어요.
던지다.x: The kids are playing catch in the park.

(이)랑.forms: 이랑 after a consonant (동생이랑), 랑 after a vowel (친구랑)
(이)랑.x: Yesterday I watched a movie with a friend.

인기 있다.forms: 인기 있어요 · 인기 있었어요 · 인기 있는 (+noun)
인기 있다.ex: 요즘 젊은 사람들에게 가장 인기 있는 음식이 뭐예요?
인기 있다.x: What food is the most popular with young people these days?
인기 있다.e: Literally 'has people's energy': people are drawn to it.
인기 있다.t: Pronounced [인끼 읻따]: the ㄱ in 인기 is tensed. Opposite: 인기 없다.

안내문.ex: 엘리베이터 앞에 점검 안내문이 붙어 있어요.
안내문.x: There's a maintenance notice posted in front of the elevator.

숙박.ex: 이 가격에는 숙박과 아침 식사가 포함돼 있어요.
숙박.x: This price includes lodging and breakfast.
숙박.t: Trip lengths use 박 for nights: 2박 3일 means 'three days, two nights.'

며느리.ex: 그 집 며느리는 시부모님께 아주 잘해요.
며느리.x: That family's daughter-in-law is very good to her in-laws.
며느리.e: Pairs with 사위 'son-in-law'; a 며느리 calls her husband's parents 시부모님.

찢다.ex: 너무 화가 나서 편지를 찢어 버렸어요.
찢다.x: I was so angry that I tore up the letter.

형성.ex: 어린 시절은 성격 형성에 큰 영향을 줘요.
형성.x: Childhood has a big influence on the formation of personality.

팔로워.ex: 그 친구는 SNS 팔로워가 만 명이 넘어요.
팔로워.x: That friend has over ten thousand followers on social media.
팔로워.t: 팔로우하다 = to follow; 맞팔 (casual) = following each other.

가계부.ex: 저는 매일 가계부를 써서 돈을 아껴요.
가계부.x: I save money by keeping a household budget every day.
가계부.t: The verb is 쓰다: 가계부를 쓰다 — to keep a budget book (apps count too).

핵가족.x: These days nuclear families are far more common than extended families.
핵가족.e: Literally 'core family', modeled on English 'nuclear family'.
핵가족.t: Pronounced [핵까족]: the ㄱ after ㄱ is tensed.

하수구.x: You shouldn't pour oil down the drain.

수치심.ex: 그는 사람들 앞에서 혼나서 수치심을 느꼈어요.
수치심.x: He felt ashamed after being scolded in front of people.
수치심.e: Literally 'shame-disgrace heart'. -심 = a feeling or mindset: 수치심, 경계심, 동정심.

팬 사인회.ex: 팬 사인회에서 좋아하는 멤버와 눈을 마주쳤어요.
팬 사인회.x: At the fan signing, I made eye contact with my favorite member.
팬 사인회.t: Spots are often given by lottery based on album purchases, so fans buy many copies.

챌린지.ex: 신곡 챌린지 영상이 SNS에서 유행하고 있어요.
챌린지.x: Challenge videos for the new song are trending on social media.
챌린지.t: In K-pop, singers post a short clip of a new song's 포인트 안무, often with other stars, and fans join in. 챌린지에 참여하다 = to take part in a challenge.

다수결.ex: 우리 반은 다수결로 여행 장소를 정했어요.
다수결.x: Our class picked the trip destination by majority vote.
다수결.t: Common pattern: 다수결로 정하다 or 다수결로 결정하다 = to decide by majority vote.

좌담회.x: The newspaper gathered experts and held a round-table discussion.

어루만지다.m: to stroke, to caress; to soothe, to console
어루만지다.x: The mother gently stroked her child's hair.
어루만지다.e: Built on 만지다 'to touch': a gentle, soothing touch, physical or emotional.

시치미.m: feigned ignorance, playing dumb (in 시치미를 떼다)
시치미.ex: 그는 자기가 한 일인데도 모른다고 시치미를 뗐어요.
시치미.x: Even though he did it himself, he played dumb and said he didn't know.
시치미.e: Originally a name tag tied to a hunting hawk; removing it hid who owned the bird.
시치미.t: Almost always used in the idiom 시치미를 떼다 (casually 시치미 떼다), 'to play dumb.'

막장.ex: 이 드라마는 막장이지만 계속 보게 돼요.
막장.x: This drama is makjang, but I keep watching it.
막장.e: Originally the dead end of a mine shaft, the last place you can go; now 'rock bottom', used for absurd plots.
막장.t: Pronounced [막짱]. Casual. A 막장 드라마 piles up affairs, birth secrets and revenge; people complain, but the ratings are often high.

재판관.ex: 헌법재판소 재판관 아홉 명이 만장일치로 결정했습니다.
재판관.x: All nine Constitutional Court justices decided unanimously.
재판관.t: In everyday speech a judge is 판사; 재판관 is the formal title for Constitutional Court justices.

상장폐지.x: The company was delisted because of accounting fraud.
상장폐지.t: Usually used with 되다: 상장폐지되다 'to be delisted.'

국가보안법.ex: 국가보안법 폐지를 둘러싸고 논쟁이 계속되고 있어요.
국가보안법.x: Debate continues over abolishing the National Security Act.
국가보안법.e: Literally 'law for keeping the nation safe'.
국가보안법.t: Often shortened to 국보법 in news headlines.

상대성이론.x: Einstein is a scientist who is very famous for the theory of relativity.
상대성이론.t: Pronounced [상대썽이론]; often spaced as 상대성 이론.

스마트기기.x: These days even young children use smart devices easily.

심미안.ex: 좋은 작품을 고르려면 뛰어난 심미안이 필요해요.
심미안.x: To choose good works, you need a keen eye for beauty.
심미안.t: Common collocation: 심미안을 기르다 means to develop an eye for beauty.

형설지공.m: success through diligent study despite hardship
형설지공.x: He studied hard against all odds and became a doctor.
형설지공.e: Literally 'achievement by firefly light and snow glow' — poor scholars reading at night.

증폭되다.m: to be amplified, to grow, to escalate (doubts, conflict)
증폭되다.x: As the explanation was delayed, the suspicions grew even more.
증폭되다.e: Literally 'widen the range' — signals, doubts, or anger getting bigger.
증폭되다.t: Typical collocations: 의혹이 증폭되다, 갈등이 증폭되다, 불안이 증폭되다.

저미다.m: to slice thin; (heart) to ache as if cut
저미다.ex: 마늘을 얇게 저며서 고기 위에 올리세요.
저미다.x: Slice the garlic thin and put it on top of the meat.
저미다.e: A kitchen verb for thin slicing, borrowed for heartache — a heart being sliced.
저미다.t: Emotional use: 가슴을 저미는 슬픔 'heart-wrenching sorrow'.

막역지우.m: a bosom friend, a very close friend
막역지우.ex: 그와 나는 어릴 때부터 막역지우로 지내 왔어요.
막역지우.x: He and I have been bosom friends since childhood.
막역지우.e: Literally 'a friend with no friction between you'.
막역지우.t: Pronounced [마격찌우]; 막역한 사이 'close relationship' is common too.
